name: Indian Sport Scout
engine: 45 cubic inch air-cooled side-valve V-twin, girder fork, recirculating oil
intro: Indian's 30s sport twin, loved by racers. A flathead V-twin with a girder fork and a geared primary.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
